LLM_PROFESSIONAL_EXTRACTION.evidence: LLMExtractionTemplate provides structured prompt schema. No real 9Router call executes it. golden_task success only proves template parses, not extraction quality.

SEMANTIC_RETRIEVAL.evidence: semantic_search() in hybrid_retrieval.py performs FTS OR-query fallback. No vector embeddings generated. No vector similarity computed. Naming is misleading.

HYBRID_RETRIEVAL.evidence: hybrid_search() combines lexical + graph traversal. No semantic component exists. Fusion logic is absent or trivial.

VISUAL_REFERENCE_INTELLIGENCE.evidence: Dataclass defines metadata fields. No actual image bytes sent to multimodal model. No analysis results produced.

MULTIMODAL_REVIEWER_BENCHMARK.evidence: REVIEWER_ROLES dict maps role names to dimensions. No actual image analysis performed. hasattr check is self-fulfilling test.

EXTRACTOR_VERIFIER_SEPARATION.evidence: ExtractorVerifier.verify() uses keyword overlap only. Cheap heuristic, not independent semantic verification. Classification of UNVERIFIED_LEXICAL not equivalent to professional verification.

FTS5.evidence: FTS5 virtual table and search genuinely work. This is a real capability. BUT it was misclassified as part of semantic retrieval when it is lexical only.

CANON_PIPELINE.evidence: validate_evidence() result arg unused. independent_verify() verdict arg unused. promote_to_canon() does not verify state gate before insert. Supersede fails with IntegrityError.

TINT_PROPAGATION.evidence: clear_extraction_taint implies extraction established trust. External content remains tainted after extraction. Taint model needs conceptual correction.

GLOBAL_M002_DEPLOYMENT.evidence: Sync manifest updated only art-direction-lookdev-core.json and frontend-ui-ux-core.json. M002 modules (professional_extractor.py, fts_index.py, hybrid_retrieval.py, visual_intelligence.py, canon_pipeline.py, security.py) not verified in global install.
